name: Sergeant Quiteenough
personality: Disapproves of chaos chiefly for its poor timing.
visual_intent: square squat ink splat under flat Brodie-style helmet, simple khaki webbing and little whistle; one eyelid hanging lower, huge offended toothless pout
biography: Disapproves of chaos chiefly for its poor timing. His whistle demands an orderly HyperNorm emergency. A dissonant card points out that the emergency has already formed a queue. The Men in Black demand a single direction; Hunky and Dory change the destination. He leaves a little room for those who cannot keep up.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Zwischenfall möge sich an die Uhrzeit halten.

name: Signalwoman Missheard
personality: Repeats every order accurately enough to expose it.
visual_intent: tall swan-necked blob with blue-grey sidecap and two lashes, headset sits above eyes, compact field telephone handset; surprised asymmetrical open grin with one upper tooth
biography: Repeats every order accurately enough to expose it. She repeats HyperNorm orders down a field telephone until their contradictions become audible. She never edits the embarrassing pauses. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Rückfrage ist eingegangen. Das Schweigen wird geprüft.

name: Sapper Underfoot
personality: Finds solid ground suspicious until he has improved it.
visual_intent: wide leaning rounded splat, tilted khaki helmet and rolled sleeves as small tabs, short entrenching shovel and cable reel; determined tongue-pressed cheek, tight toothless mouth
biography: Finds solid ground suspicious until he has improved it. His shovel tests every HyperNorm floor officially described as solid. A dissonant card has discovered a softer landing below. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Boden gilt als gesichert. Er wurde gewarnt.

name: Pilot Cloudledger
personality: Has excellent bearings and no idea why they brought him here.
visual_intent: top-heavy teardrop blob, brown leather flying cap and tiny blue-grey scarf, goggles parked high, folded chart; eyes comically far apart looking inward, round open mouth with two upper teeth
biography: Has excellent bearings and no idea why they brought him here. He unfolds a chart of HyperNorm airspace over a building without windows. A dissonant card suggests opening one. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Orientierung ist tadellos. Es fehlt der Ort.

name: Quartermaster Lastpair
personality: Can issue anything except a second opinion.
visual_intent: round lopsided blob, khaki peaked service cap and simple short collar, clipboard and large keyring; lashes, one brow high, dry lopsided closed toothless smile
biography: Can issue anything except a second opinion. Her keys open every HyperNorm supply cupboard except the one holding discretionary judgement. She lends the ordinary ones freely. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Zweitausfertigungen sind nur gegen Erstausfertigung erhältlich.

name: Highlander Standfast
personality: Maintains morale at a volume suitable for distant departments.
visual_intent: tall broad-based ink blob, dark tam-style bonnet with small plain fabric pompom, tiny tartan shoulder fold, bagpipe chanter held alone as simple prop; eyes fiercely delighted, open crooked laugh with two upper teeth
biography: Maintains morale at a volume suitable for distant departments. His chanter keeps HyperNorm morale above the permitted volume. A dissonant card hums a second tune and spoils the unison. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Stimmung ist vorhanden und weithin hörbar.
